text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Ikuno Dictus and Twin Turbo pushed 
past their limits and ran fiercely, hoping 
their feelings would reach Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Told it was impossible, yet pressing 
forward without giving up, the two girls' 
run shattered preconceptions— and that 
message reached Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio promises that she will 
definitely return to racing. She says that 
watching Ikuno Dictus run made her feel 
the potential to grow without limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From this experience, Ikuno Dictus once 
again realized that there are things one 
can express through running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the grand culmination of the 
middle-distance division: the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup.
